ActionParameters.Value:
INSERT INTO app.StagiuCotizare
(
    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Identificare
    -------------------------------------------------
    Marca,
    CodSucursala,
    Luna,
    Anul,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Zile payroll
    -------------------------------------------------
    ZileLucrate,
    ZileCO,
    ZileCM,
    ZileCFS,
    ZileNemotivate,
    ZileDelegatie,
    ZileAsimilate,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Ore payroll
    -------------------------------------------------
    OreLucrate,
    OreCO,
    OreCM,
    OreSuspendate,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Venituri contributive
    -------------------------------------------------
    VenitCAS,
    VenitCASS,
    VenitCAM,
    VenitCM,
    VenitFNUASS,
    VenitBrut,
    VenitImpozabil,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Contributii
    -------------------------------------------------
    CASRetinut,
    CASSRetinut,
    CAMCalculat,
    ImpozitRetinut,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Date contractuale / D112
    -------------------------------------------------
    TipContract,
    TipNorma,
    NormaZilnica,
    TipAsigurat,
    TipVenitD112,
    ConditiiMunca,
    CodIndemnizatieCM,
    CodCOR,
    CasaPensii,
    CasaSanatate,
    Judet,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Situatii speciale
    -------------------------------------------------
    EsteCCC,
    EsteCM,
    EstePensionar,
    EsteScutitCAS,
    EsteScutitCASS,
    ContractSuspendat,
    AreFacilitati,
    EsteAsimilat,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Tip stagiu
    -------------------------------------------------
    TipStagiu,
    AnStagiu,
    LunaStagiu,

    CodFunctie,

    CodUrgentaCM,
    EsteCMContinuare,
    EsteCMCronic,
    ProcCM,

    ZileCMUnitate,
    ZileCMFNUASS,


    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Audit
    -------------------------------------------------
    EsteProcesat,
    Status,
    MesajValidare,
    DataCalcul,
    CreatedDate
)

SELECT

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Identificare
    -------------------------------------------------
    ep.Marca,
    ep.CodSucursala,
    ep.Luna,
    ep.Anul,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Zile payroll
    -------------------------------------------------
    ISNULL(ep.ZileLucrateTotal,0) AS ZileLucrate,

    ISNULL(ep.ZileCO,0) AS ZileCO,

    ISNULL(ep.ZileCM,0) AS ZileCM,

    ISNULL(ep.ZileCFS,0) AS ZileCFS,

    ISNULL(ep.ZileNemotivate,0) AS ZileNemotivate,

    ISNULL(ep.ZileDelegatie,0) AS ZileDelegatie,

    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(s.Stare,0) = 1
        THEN ISNULL(ep.ZileLucrateTotal,0)
        ELSE 0
    END AS ZileAsimilate,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Ore payroll
    -------------------------------------------------
    ISNULL(ep.OreLucrate,0) AS OreLucrate,

    ISNULL(ep.ZileCO,0)
        * CAST(ISNULL(s.TipNorma,1) * 8 AS INT) AS OreCO,

    ISNULL(ep.ZileCM,0)
        * CAST(ISNULL(s.TipNorma,1) * 8 AS INT) AS OreCM,

    (
        ISNULL(ep.ZileCFS,0)
        +
        ISNULL(ep.ZileNemotivate,0)
    )
        * CAST(ISNULL(s.TipNorma,1) * 8 AS INT) AS OreSuspendate,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Venituri contributive
    -------------------------------------------------
    ISNULL(bc.BazaCAS,0) AS VenitCAS,

    ISNULL(bc.BazaCASS,0) AS VenitCASS,

    ISNULL(bc.BazaCAM,0) AS VenitCAM,

    0 AS VenitCM,

    0 AS VenitFNUASS,

    ISNULL(bc.BrutTotal,0) AS VenitBrut,

    ISNULL(bc.VenitImpozabil,0) AS VenitImpozabil,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Contributii
    -------------------------------------------------
    ISNULL(bc.CAS,0) AS CASRetinut,

    ISNULL(bc.CASS,0) AS CASSRetinut,

    ISNULL(bc.CAM,0) AS CAMCalculat,

    ISNULL(bc.ImpozitFinal,0) AS ImpozitRetinut,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Date contractuale / D112
    -------------------------------------------------
    ISNULL(s.TipAngajare,'STANDARD') AS TipContract,

    ISNULL(s.TipNorma,1) AS TipNorma,

    CAST(ISNULL(s.TipNorma,1) * 8 AS INT) AS NormaZilnica,

    '' AS TipAsigurat,

    'SALAR' AS TipVenitD112,

    'Normale' AS ConditiiMunca,

    '' AS CodIndemnizatieCM,

   ISNULL(s.CodFunctie,0) AS CodCOR, --de adaugat cod COR din nomenclator COR

    '' AS CasaPensii,

    ISNULL(s.CodSanatate,'') AS CasaSanatate,

    ISNULL(s.Judet,'') AS Judet,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Situatii speciale
    -------------------------------------------------
    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(s.Stare,0) = 1
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS EsteCCC,

    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(ep.ZileCM,0) > 0
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS EsteCM,

    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(s.Stare,0) = 3
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS EstePensionar,

    0 AS EsteScutitCAS,

    0 AS EsteScutitCASS,

    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(s.Stare,0) = 7
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS ContractSuspendat,

    0 AS AreFacilitati,

    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(s.Stare,0) = 1
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS EsteAsimilat,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Tip stagiu
    -------------------------------------------------
    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(s.Stare,0) = 1
        THEN 'CCC'

        WHEN ISNULL(ep.ZileCM,0) > 0
        THEN 'CM'

        ELSE 'CONTRIBUTIV'
    END AS TipStagiu,
    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Campuri CM / Stagiu
    -------------------------------------------------

    ep.Anul AS AnStagiu,

    ep.Luna AS LunaStagiu,

    ISNULL(s.CodFunctie,0) AS CodFunctie,

    0 AS CodUrgentaCM,

    0 AS EsteCMContinuare,

    0 AS EsteCMCronic,

    0 AS ProcCM,

    0 AS ZileCMUnitate,

    0 AS ZileCMFNUASS,


    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Audit
    -------------------------------------------------
    0 AS EsteProcesat,

    1 AS Status,

    '' AS MesajValidare,

    SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AS DataCalcul,

    SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AS CreatedDate

FROM app.ExceptiiPrezenta ep

INNER JOIN app.BazaContributii bc
    ON bc.Marca = ep.Marca
   AND bc.Luna = ep.Luna
   AND bc.Anul = ep.Anul
   AND bc.CodSucursala = ep.CodSucursala

INNER JOIN app.Salariat s
    ON s.Marca = ep.Marca

WHERE ep.Luna = @Luna
  AND ep.Anul = @Anul
  AND ep.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

UPDATE sc
SET

    sc.ZileStagiuCAS =

        ISNULL(sc.ZileLucrate,0)

        + ISNULL(sc.ZileCO,0)

        + ISNULL(sc.ZileCM,0)

        - ISNULL(sc.ZileCFS,0)

        - ISNULL(sc.ZileNemotivate,0),

    sc.LastModifiedDate = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()

FROM app.StagiuCotizare sc

WHERE sc.Luna = @Luna
  AND sc.Anul = @Anul
  AND sc.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

ActionParameters.Value:
UPDATE sc
SET

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Flag CM
    -------------------------------------------------
    sc.EsteCM =

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(cm.ZileCM,0) > 0
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Zile CM
    -------------------------------------------------
    sc.ZileCM =

        ISNULL(cm.ZileCM,0),

    sc.ZileCMUnitate =

        ISNULL(cm.ZileCMUnitate,0),

    sc.ZileCMFNUASS =

        ISNULL(cm.ZileCMFNUASS,0),

    sc.ZileStagiuCM =

        ISNULL(cm.NrZileStagiuCotiz,0),

    sc.ZileAsimilate =

        ISNULL(cm.NrZileAsimilate,0),

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Venituri CM
    -------------------------------------------------
    sc.VenitCM =

        ISNULL(cm.SumaUnitate,0),

    sc.VenitFNUASS =

        ISNULL(cm.SumaPlatitadinCAS,0),

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Audit CM
    -------------------------------------------------
    sc.ProcCM =

        ISNULL(cm.ProcentCM,0),

    sc.CodIndemnizatieCM =

        cm.Codindemn,

    sc.CodUrgentaCM =

        cm.CodUrgenta,

    sc.EsteCMCronic =

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(cm.Cronic,'NU') = 'DA'
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END,

    sc.EsteCMContinuare =

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(cm.CMContinuare,'NU') = 'DA'
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Audit
    -------------------------------------------------
    sc.LastModifiedDate = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET(),

    sc.EsteProcesat = 0

FROM app.StagiuCotizare sc

LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT

        cm.Marca,
        cm.Luna,
        cm.Anul,
        cm.CodSucursala,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Zile CM
        -------------------------------------------------
        SUM
        (
            ISNULL(cm.ZilePlatiteUnitate,0)
            +
            ISNULL(cm.ZilePlatitedinCAS,0)
        ) AS ZileCM,

        SUM
        (
            ISNULL(cm.ZilePlatiteUnitate,0)
        ) AS ZileCMUnitate,

        SUM
        (
            ISNULL(cm.ZilePlatitedinCAS,0)
        ) AS ZileCMFNUASS,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Sume CM
        -------------------------------------------------
        SUM
        (
            ISNULL(cm.SumaUnitate,0)
        ) AS SumaUnitate,

        SUM
        (
            ISNULL(cm.SumaPlatitadinCAS,0)
        ) AS SumaPlatitadinCAS,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Stagiu
        -------------------------------------------------
        MAX
        (
            ISNULL(cm.NrZileStagiuCotiz,0)
        ) AS NrZileStagiuCotiz,

        MAX
        (
            ISNULL(cm.NrZileAsimilate,0)
        ) AS NrZileAsimilate,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Audit CM
        -------------------------------------------------
        MAX
        (
            ISNULL(cm.ProcentCM,0)
        ) AS ProcentCM,

        MAX(cm.Codindemn) AS Codindemn,

        MAX(cm.CodUrgenta) AS CodUrgenta,

        MAX(cm.Cronic) AS Cronic,

        MAX(cm.CMContinuare) AS CMContinuare

    FROM app.ConcediuMedical cm

    GROUP BY

        cm.Marca,
        cm.Luna,
        cm.Anul,
        cm.CodSucursala

) cm

    ON cm.Marca = sc.Marca
   AND cm.Luna = sc.Luna
   AND cm.Anul = sc.Anul
   AND cm.CodSucursala = sc.CodSucursala

WHERE sc.Luna = @Luna
  AND sc.Anul = @Anul
  AND sc.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

UPDATE sc

    sc.TipStagiu =

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(sc.EsteCCC,0) = 1
                THEN 'CCC'

            WHEN ISNULL(sc.EsteCM,0) = 1
                THEN 'CM'

            WHEN ISNULL(sc.EsteAsimilat,0) = 1
                THEN 'ASIMILAT'

            ELSE 'CONTRIBUTIV'
        END,

    sc.LastModifiedDate = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()

FROM app.StagiuCotizare sc

WHERE sc.Luna = @Luna
  AND sc.Anul = @Anul
  AND sc.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
